summary: Isolated live smoke against the saved dyaus SSH host and empirical-forge workdir launched the resolved remote Codex 0.146.0 binary in tmux, observed the session alive after the startup window, and cleaned it up without touching saved sessions.

Live Codex smoke accepted mcp_servers.agentum.bearer_token_env_var with the token supplied only through the staged child environment; executor and host-runtime tests assert the literal token is absent from argv, generated shell commands, and redacted errors.

Server/runtime unit tests pass for remote prerequisite, SSH stage, tmux setup, tunnel, canonical missing-session, and early-exit classifications; the API maps actionable prerequisites to 400 and upstream failures to 502.

Live remote exit-42 smoke preserved 'agentum smoke diagnostic', returned the exit status, and verified that the failed tmux target was removed; deterministic transaction tests assert pipe-before-respawn and cleanup ordering.

Startup-resume and session-start tests pass: only Idle rows resume through the shared host-aware start operation, explicitly Stopped rows stay stopped, and persisted SSH targets are preferred after rename.

Live plain-terminal smoke resolved and launched /bin/fish on the remote host; executor and TUI routing tests verify remote shell selection and preservation of selected profile, host_id, client, and workdir.

Ratatui TestBackend and pure layout tests pass for JSON error-envelope decoding, multiline and narrow-width wrapping without truncation, visual-row scrolling, bottom navigation, clear, and close behavior.

All 35 agentum-tmux tests pass, covering agent/key/password command construction, keyboard-interactive password auth, -T, stale multiplex recovery, typed has-session errors, ControlMaster shutdown, safe quoting, and timeout child cleanup; live password-host smoke also passed.

cargo check --workspace --all-targets and cargo test --workspace --all-targets both pass after adding deterministic regressions across executor, tmux transport, server runtime/lifecycle, and TUI API/layout/routing.
